# external/ (SAFE NOW)

**Ultrastable is the foundation for any autonomous system.**

A system is autonomous if it has self-referential loops and the ability to close them. Knowing without being able to act is useless, so the system is privileged to close its own loops (`python3 -m foundation loops --verify`).

**Ultrastable runs on itself.** Its own planning, work tracking and reporting are run by the system it gives to others.

The only files meant to leave this private repository before the license review is complete and the repositories are published. Outcome-level and non-enabling: no mechanisms, numbers from the system, architecture, schemas or claim language. Rules: [../docs/CONFIDENTIALITY.md](../docs/CONFIDENTIALITY.md). Review each file against that rule before sending; a human (the owner) sends it.

| File | Use |
|---|---|
| [overview.md](overview.md) | Anyone asking what Ultrastable is |
| [one-pager.md](one-pager.md) | Angels, partners, event organizers |
| [customer-story.md](customer-story.md) | Same, with a self-reported caveat |
| [security-summary.md](security-summary.md) | Customer questionnaires |
| [google-startups-answers.md](google-startups-answers.md) | Google for Startups Cloud Program form |
| [../instances/ultrastable/briefing/](../instances/ultrastable/briefing/README.md) (pitch-deck, elevator-pitches, faq, qa answers) | SAFE NOW text; competitor-map and objection-handling are internal |
